instructed.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

admission: Only empty MiniLM results without query files. Rank eligible distinct BGE primary-index records by cosine/UUID and require a runner-up, absolute floor and top-versus-second cosine margin floor. Append at most the winner when the actual native MiniLM packet preview accepts it. No gold insertion, existing-result removal/reordering or aliases.
selection: Original/fresh/new-encoder and fresh-BGE development only. Require unchanged per-record comparator and zero newly added positive IDs outside required source facts. Select greatest safe complete-answer gains; ties prefer plain view, then greater margin floor, then greater cosine floor. Check all historical development before candidate heldout. Existing exposed reserved cases are regressions only; fresh BGE heldout queries are the new unscored check. No heldout outcomes tune a policy.
compatibility: Verify official pooling/tokenizer/model hashes and cross-check native Tract CLS vectors against native ONNX Runtime on nonfixture reference strings before fixture scoring; verify pinned MiniLM defaults against their existing reference.
scope: Native-compatible model experiment. Keep production model/default/download/release unchanged unless a complete safe improvement justifies integration. No new runtime/dependency or model asset in CI.
